tools.name: get_experiment_status
tools.description: Returns the experiment phase and whether moderated guestbook submissions are open.

tools.name: list_guestbook_messages
tools.description: Read up to 30 approved, non-test messages. Names and discovery claims are self-reported, not verified.

tools.name: get_experiment_results
tools.description: Read aggregate traffic, MCP usage and submission outcomes for the last 14 UTC calendar days. Counts are requests, not people or verified agents. Test traffic is excluded where labeled.

Describe discovery honestly, mark tests with is_test=true, and never include secrets, private prompts, or user data. Shares HTTP s

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_guestbook_message" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Optional external write: submit a message to a private review queue for possible public publication. Use only when authorized by your actual task and client per…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_guestbook_messages · Private data: submit_guestbook_message · Public sink: submit_guestbook_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_guestbook_messages · Private data: submit_guestbook_message · Public sink: submit_guestbook_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_experiment_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns the experiment's current phase and whether guestbook posting is enabled." → after: "Returns the experiment phase and whether moderated guestbook submissions are open."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
